name: Cồn Phụng
kicker: Orchard islet of the Coconut Monk on the Tiền
summary: Orchard islet on the Tiền: walk the nine-dragon court and the candy kiln for a river day. Nine dragons stand for the nine Mekong mouths, with the tower and Cửu Trùng đài beside them. Go when that court and the kiln are the day. Leave it when the lake in town is the only walk you wanted.
getThere: About 10–12 km by road and 25 km by river. The town pier is a separate landing.
heroCaption: The nine-dragon court, with the tower behind it

notice.title: Book the islet landing
notice.body: The town pier and the Friday town cart stay in town. Thới Sơn is the Mỹ Tho bank of the river.

body: Walk Tòa Bảo tháp, Sân Rồng, and Cửu Trùng đài. Nine dragons in the court stand for the nine mouths of the Mekong. The islet covers over 50 ha. Ask for old xã Tân Thạch, huyện Châu Thành, or for ấp 10 (Ấp Tân Vinh), xã Phú Túc. Both names find the same landing. The road from the city center is about 10–12 km, and the river route is 25 km.

On the same ground you can watch coconut candy and rice paper made, see more than 500 shell-craft objects, sit for honey tea and đờn ca tài tử, take a horse cart under the palms, and ride a sampan in a nipa creek. Give it a river day. The four names on this bank are Long, Lân, Quy, and Phụng. Lân has no bank named. The town pier is a separate landing.

gettingThere: From the city center the road is about 10–12 km, and the river route is 25 km. The fare is Check on arrival. The Friday seven-seat cart stays on the town streets.

legs.heading: From Ben Tre
legs.body: By road, about 10–12 km, or by river, 25 km. Minutes are Check on arrival. The town orchard boat uses bến tàu du lịch thành phố Bến Tre, a separate landing.

admissionNote: The gate and a separate ecology tour are different charges.
